rationale: Glucose is the preferred fermentable substrate; ammonium is the primary nitrogen source. Nitrogen availability (9.347 mM) limits growth to ~0.25 /h. Fermentation yields acetate, propionate, butyrate, and CO₂ in typical Bacteroides ratio. Mass balance: 60 mmol C in (10 mmol glucose) → 10.25 mmol C biomass + ~32.75 mmol C products; 2 mmol N in (ammonium) → 0.5 mmol N biomass.
